# fjordrun_function (Resource)

A serverless function: a handler on a Fjordrun runtime, from inline code or a GitHub directory, with its own URL in every environment.

A function is also a service, so `fjordrun_service_variables`, `fjordrun_domain` and `fjordrun_deployment` work with its `id`. Like a service it exists in every environment of the project: this resource manages its settings in `environment_id`; `fjordrun_function_environment` manages them in another.

**Deployments.** By default changes are saved and don't go live until a deployment: use `fjordrun_deployment` with `code_sha256` among its triggers, or `auto_deploy = true`, which deploys once per apply of this resource.

~> `token` is kept in Terraform state: use an encrypted remote state backend.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "fjordrun_project" "shop" {
  team_id = var.team_id
  name    = "shop"
}

resource "fjordrun_function" "hello" {
  project_id     = fjordrun_project.shop.id
  environment_id = fjordrun_project.shop.default_environment_id
  name           = "hello"
  runtime        = "node22"

  files = {
    "index.mjs" = <<-EOT
      export default async (request) => Response.json({ hello: "world" });
    EOT
  }

  memory_mb      = 256
  timeout_s      = 30
  concurrency    = 10
  max_replicas   = 2
  idle_timeout_s = 120
  auth           = "token"

  # deploy by itself, and report failures
  auto_deploy = true
  wait        = true
}

output "url" {
  value = fjordrun_function.hello.url
}

output "token" {
  value     = fjordrun_function.hello.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) The environment whose settings this resource manages.
- `name` (String) Function name (1-100 characters, unique among the project's services).
- `project_id` (String) Project ID.

### Optional

- `auth` (String) `public` (default): anyone with the URL. `token`: requests need `token` in the `token_header` header.
- `auto_deploy` (Boolean) Deploy when this resource is created or changes. Leave out to use the provider's `auto_deploy` (default `false`: the change is saved and goes live with the next deployment, which `fjordrun_deployment` makes explicit, so an apply with several changes to a service makes one deployment).
- `concurrency` (Number) Requests in flight per instance before another starts (1-100, default 10).
- `entry` (String) The file that exports the handler, relative to the code root. Defaults to `index.mjs` or `main.py`.
- `files` (Map of String) Inline code: file contents by relative path, up to 100 files and 256 KB in all (`package.json` or `requirements.txt` declare dependencies). Use `file("...")` to load them. Conflicts with `source`. Leave both out for the runtime's starter code, which this resource then doesn't manage. Code is shared by all the function's environments.
- `idle_timeout_s` (Number) How long an instance stays up after its last request, billed as instance time (30-900, default 120). The Trial plan fixes it at 60: any other value is an error there.
- `max_replicas` (Number) Most instances (1-50, default 1). Plans limit it.
- `memory_mb` (Number) Memory: 128, 256 (default), 512, 1024, 2048 or 4096 MB. Plans limit it. CPU follows from memory.
- `rotate_token_trigger` (String) Change this value to rotate `token`. With `auth = "token"`, rotating redeploys a running function, whatever `auto_deploy` says: the old token keeps working until the new deployment is live.
- `runtime` (String) `node22` (default) or `python312`. Changing it moves a default `entry` along.
- `source` (Attributes) Code from a directory of a GitHub repository, instead of `files`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source))
- `timeout_s` (Number) Seconds a request may run (1-900, default 30). Plans limit it.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `wait` (Boolean) With `auto_deploy`: wait until the deployment finishes, up to the `create`/`update` timeout (default 30 minutes), and fail the apply unless it succeeds.

### Read-Only

- `code_sha256` (String) Hash of the saved inline code, shared by all environments. Null for code from GitHub.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `deployed_sha256` (String) Hash of the inline code the live deployment runs. Equal to `code_sha256` once the saved code is deployed.
- `id` (String) Function ID (it is also a service ID).
- `slug` (String) URL-safe name, used in hostnames.
- `status` (String) Status in this environment: `inactive`, `building`, `deploying`, `active`, `sleeping`, `failed`...
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The token callers send, with `auth = "token"`. Null otherwise. Each environment has its own.
- `token_header` (String) The header that carries the token, with `auth = "token"`.
- `url` (String) The function's URL in this environment.

<a id="nestedatt--source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source`

Required:

- `repo` (String) `owner/name` of the repository.

Optional:

- `branch` (String) Branch. Leave out for the default branch.
- `root_dir` (String) The function's directory in the repository.


<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# function_id/environment_id
terraform import fjordrun_function.hello cccccccc-cccc-cccc-cccc-cccccccccccc/66666666-6666-6666-6666-666666666666
```
